blocks.text: SAN FRANCISCO, AGUSAN DEL SUR, Philippines — Some 20 people have died from mosquito-borne dengue infection in Agusan del Sur province in the last 10 months, with the number of cases continuing to rise in the past five weeks. The last two deaths happened between Tuesday and Wednesday this week. From only 14 deaths as of Oct. 1, the fatalities climbed to 20 with the addition of six deaths in five weeks, data from the Provincial Health Office (PHO) showed.
